# Maktabah Muhammadiya

> Curated Islamic bookshop offering Arabic and Urdu titles, modest clothing, and selected essentials with personal order support.

Maktabah Muhammadiya is an online Islamic bookshop. The catalog is organized by
subject (Aqeedah, Tafsir, Hadith, Fiqh, Seerah, Qur'an, Purification, Character,
Family, Women's issues, Islamic history) and includes Arabic books, Urdu books,
and modest clothing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, new arrivals, and curated rails.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalog with filtering by category, language, price, availability, and rating.
- [About](/about): About the bookshop, curation approach, and customer support.
- [Contact](/contact): Order support, WhatsApp channel, Instagram, and FAQ.

## Catalog Focus

- Aqeedah
- Tafsir
- Hadith
- Fiqh
- Seerah
- Qur'an
- Purification
- Character development
- Family and marriage
- Women's issues
- Islamic history
- Arabic books
- Urdu books
- Modest clothing
